card.name: Inside drug names, before dosing text
card.fires_on: Mostly the last piece of a drug name (lanthanum, ferumoxytol, epoetin, maltose) or a word right after a drug name or a risk list, such as "that" or "formulations". It appears in dosing and prescribing sections of drug labels.

modes.label: End of drug name
modes.description: The final or middle piece of a long drug or brand name, just before a noun like carbonate, alfa or injection.

modes.label: Word after drug or risk term
modes.description: A linking word or noun after a drug name or in a list of risk factors, where the text continues with a list or comparison.
modes.example: risk factor for<< addiction>>, abuse, and misuse.

card.writes: It seems to suppress words like "or" and "either", so it pushes toward the text continuing as a name or list rather than an alternative.
card.plain: It fires inside long drug names and on a few words after them in label text.
